rule: Intro is one countdown (sys.intro) walked through round states. A super is a pause: time 30, darken 0.5, unhittable pause+1, opponent defence x1.5 in the combo. Stun is a points meter: each normal hit adds damage x1.8 divided by the victim's defence, supers add 0, max defaults to life, 60-tick cooldown after a non-guarded hit, meter resets when the victim is not in hit or lying state, and only one stun per combo.
keep: One intro countdown with a fixed order: intros, round call, fight call, control.
Super freeze of 30 ticks with half darkening, so the super is one readable beat.
Stagger meter that divides by defence, so tanky targets fill it slower.
One stun per combo, with the meter reset after the victim is free of hits.
No damage in the short outro window between over hit time and over wait time (src/system.go:1867).
change: Stagger max as a boss data field, not the boss's life (donor default is life).
Hits from all attackers (up to 3) count toward the same stagger meter.
Freeze the boss and the caller, and hold the other attackers for the same ticks (donor freeze rule for other characters was not read in full).
Server owns the freeze timer, stagger count and one-stun flag; client draws only.
look_test: Preview clips at 375 wide on the existing boss: (1) heavy move as today, (2) same move with 30-tick freeze and half-brightness screen, (3) stagger bar plus birds and 30-tick red flash after three heavy hits. Dom judges whether the freeze reads as a moment and whether the birds read at phone size.
